## Sources (how this label entered the ledger)
- **OBJECT-INDEX** (batch B0033, scope OBJECT): Step 160's five-category classification of remaining architecture work (the DELTA): D1 Formalization (concept exists implicitly, lacks explicit semantic representation), D2 Integration (mechanisms exist separately, lack governed relationships), D3 Enforcement (rule exists, not mechanically enforced), D4 Evidence (behavior exists, cannot yet be adequately proven), D5 Missing capability (concept not currently represented); recommends prioritizing D1/D2/D4 (semantic consolidation) over D5 (net-new capability), on the estimate that 60-80% of needed technical mechanisms may already exist but are distributed across different architectural surfaces.
